title: REST Principles
description: Learn rest principles in ASP.NET Core.

blocks.text: REST uses standard HTTP verbs and resource-based URLs for scalable APIs.

blocks.code:
GET    /api/products       -> List products
GET    /api/products/1     -> Get product
POST   /api/products       -> Create product
PUT    /api/products/1     -> Update product
DELETE /api/products/1     -> Delete product
